stem: The demographic structure of the United States changed in the late nineteenth century with the arrival of —

options.label: A
options.text: immigrants from southern and eastern Europe seeking industrial jobs

options.label: B
options.text: political refugees coming to the United States from the former Spanish colonies

options.label: C
options.text: migrants from Mexico seeking agricultural jobs during a worldwide depression

options.label: D
options.text: German immigrants fleeing Europe prior to the outbreak of the First World War
